label: Set
text: Synthetic: 29 photoreal frames generated for this demo. No real photos.

label: People
text: Four fictional adults, written as 35 to 47 years old. None depicts or imitates a real person.

label: Content
text: Bland to mildly suggestive (one-piece swimsuits, gym wear, a slip dress); no nudity. Reject frames are made to fail blur, resolution, aspect ratio, duplicate and watermark checks.

label: Checkpoint
text: CyberRealistic XL Desire v2.0 (SDXL), CreativeML Open RAIL-M.

label: Identity
text: InstantID (Apache-2.0). Its face encoder, InsightFace antelopev2, has non-commercial research weights; used only for this non-commercial demo.
